title: Effectiveness of Workplace Safety Time-out at Construction Sites
what_it_is: Effectiveness of Workplace Safety Time-out at Construction Sites

sections.label: Incident worksites stop-work orders
sections.summary: None of the 14 incident worksites had previously been issued stop-work orders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: None of the 14 incident worksites had previously been issued with stop-work orders.

sections.label: 2024 inspections and WSH measures
sections.summary: In 2024 over 3,000 inspections targeted Working at Height, Vehicular Safety and Struck by Falling Objects, and MAST introduced measures including the Safety Disqualification Framework and video surveillance requirements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: In 2024, more than 3,000 inspections were conducted, targeting key concerns such as Working at Height, Vehicular Safety and Struck by Falling Objects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: To improve industry-level WSH outcomes, the Multi-Agency Workplace Safety and Health Taskforce (MAST), which includes partners such as the Ministry of National Development (MND), Building and Construction Authority (BCA), and the WSH Council Industry Committees, has also introduced several measures to enhance WSH standards in the construction sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: These include: (a) subjecting all public construction projects to the Safety Disqualification Framework, which temporarily bars contractors with poor WSH performance from tendering; and (b) requiring all construction worksites with contract values of $5 million and above to install video surveillance systems.

sections.label: Fatality rate and construction fatalities
sections.summary: The fatality rate has fallen, averaging 1.1 per 100,000 workers, but construction fatalities remain over-represented, almost half of Singapore's fatalities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Overall, our fatality rate has fallen over the years, averaging 1.1 per 100,000 workers, and is among the top performers worldwide.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: However, construction fatalities remain over-represented in Singapore with almost half our fatalities coming from the sector.

sections.label: Video surveillance for large projects
sections.summary: Measures introduced last year require companies with projects above $5 million to install video surveillance systems.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Having said that, we have also done more extensive measures, all introduced just last year, for example, requiring companies with projects above $5 million to put video surveillance systems.

sections.label: Disqualification criteria for sub-contractors
sections.summary: Since last year, disqualification criteria make the contractor and all levels of sub-contractors accountable, instead of only two levels.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Within the construction sector, one of the key changes we also made in terms of the disqualification criteria was, for example, in the past, we only made the contractor and the two levels of sub-contractors accountable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Since last year, we have also now made it so for the contractor and all levels of sub-contractors accountable as well.

sections.label: Small firms share of number
sections.summary: Small firms form a significant portion of that number, about close to half or one third.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Small firms do form a significant portion of that number, which I think is about close to half or one third.

sections.label: Demerit points and debarment system
sections.summary: The demerit points system debars firms from public sector contracts, with a fatality triggering debarment of at least three months at 25 points.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: To the Member's first question on the demerit points system, we have enhanced it in the last year or the last couple of years, if I recall correctly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: We brought down the debarment categories, in the sense that, now, it covers all Government Procurement Officers who procure construction work.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The debarment points system debars a firm for at least three months at 25 points and that gets triggered when you have one fatality.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, to some extent, if a company incurs more points, almost like the traffic demerit points system, whether it is MOM inspections, finding stop-work orders or other contraventions, even minor injuries, major injuries, that adds up the demerit points.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, just to assure the Member that, yes, a fatality will trigger certain responses and it depends on demerit points over an 18-month period, for example, just like the traffic violation systems, it will debar them from public sector contracts.
